hooks.name: SDLC stage gate
hooks.description: Blocks writes to source files until the AI-Native SDLC artifact chain (intent.md -> spec.md -> plan.md) is accepted for the slug named in .sdlc/active. Artifacts, evals and .github stay writable so a change can be started. Inert in a repo with no .sdlc/ directory. The command self-disables (exit 0) when python3 or the gate script is unavailable: under Kiro's contract ANY non-zero exit blocks the tool, so an infrastructure problem must not brick every write.

action.command: sh -c 'g="$HOME/.kiro/crew/skills/ai-native-sdlc/scripts/sdlc_pretooluse_hook.py"; command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; [ -f "$g" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$g"'
